answer_1.quote: A computer-aided reporting system aims to automatically generate accurate reports, which has the potential to lighten the workload of physicians and economize insufficient clinical resources in populated areas.
answer_1.outputs: Diagnostic reports for Brain CT imaging

answer_2.quote: We fully evaluate the performance on the NLG (Natural Language Generation) and CE (Clinical Evaluation) metrics. NLG metrics contains BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L and CIDEr, which are denoted as B1, B2, B3, B4, M, RG, and C.
